steps.title: Stand tall, arm relaxed
steps.text: Face forward and let your arm hang by your side. From now to the end: keep your feet planted and do not turn your body.

steps.title: Sync flicks
steps.text: Hand by your side. On each beep, flick your forearm up to your shoulder and back down, as fast as you can. Only the elbow moves. Three times.

steps.title: Calibration pose
steps.text: Raise your arm straight out in front of you, level with the floor, palm down. Hold completely still.

steps.title: Forearm twists
steps.text: Keep the arm straight out in front. Slowly turn the palm up, then back down. Three times.

steps.title: Elbow only: arm at your side
steps.text: Upper arm stays against your body. Bend the elbow so the hand comes to your shoulder, then lower it. Six slow curls.

steps.title: Elbow only: upper arm forward
steps.text: Hold your upper arm straight out in front, level with the floor. Move only the elbow: hand toward your face and back. Six reps.

steps.title: Elbow only: upper arm to the side
steps.text: Hold your upper arm out to the side, level, elbow bent. Straighten and bend only the elbow. Six reps.

steps.title: Shoulder only: raise forward
steps.text: Keep the arm straight. Raise it forward from your side up to level, then lower it. Six reps. Do not bend the elbow.

steps.title: Shoulder only: raise sideways
steps.text: Keep the arm straight. Raise it out to the side up to level, then lower it. Six reps.

steps.title: Shoulder only: swing backward
steps.text: Keep the arm straight. Swing it backward behind you and return. Six reps.

steps.title: Shoulder only: across the body
steps.text: Keep the arm straight. Hold it level in front, sweep it across your chest and back. Six reps.

steps.title: Shoulder rotation
steps.text: Upper arm against your side, elbow bent 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward. Rotate at the shoulder so the hand swings outward and back, like a door. Elbow stays at your side. Six reps.

steps.title: Shoulder and elbow together
steps.text: Raise the arm forward while curling the elbow at the same time, then lower. Six reps.

steps.title: Very slow shoulder raise
steps.text: Straight arm. Raise it forward very slowly, five seconds up, five seconds down. Twice.

steps.title: Very slow elbow curl
steps.text: Arm at your side. Curl very slowly, five seconds up, five seconds down. Twice.

steps.title: Free movement
steps.text: Wave your arm around in any direction. Mix shoulder and elbow, vary the speed, stop and start. Keep your feet planted.

activity.title: Your activity: {ACT}
activity.text: Do your {ACT} motion. First slowly, then at normal speed.

after_activity.title: Free movement again
after_activity.text: Wave your arm around in any direction, different from last time.

after_activity.title: Sync flicks again
after_activity.text: Hand by your side. On each beep, flick your forearm up to your shoulder and back down, fast. Three times.

after_activity.title: Stand tall, arm relaxed
after_activity.text: Arm hanging by your side. Done in a moment.

note: Session steps used by collect.html. {ACT} in the activity step is replaced by the chosen activity.
